terminal_policy: Manifest and verification cannot hash themselves. Nine terminal files are explicitly excluded from this body inventory. The driver receipt pins the manifest, verification, and six exact terminal streams after their creation; the driver's own receipt pin is reported externally to the parent. Every terminal file is separately chmod'ed and measured 0444. No other file exclusion is allowed.
private_artifact_policy: All third-party sources/renderings/raw searches and streams remain under private/, excluded by .gitignore private/. No Git or external writes performed.
remaining: Separate verifier process must reread all body pins, the earlier source gate, and all twelve package inputs.
